leads.claim: The Panel reviewed motion picture film evidence of UAP sightings provided by ATIC.
leads.why: The document confirms the physical possession and analysis of motion picture film evidence by the Air Technical Intelligence Center (ATIC) and a review panel.
leads.quote: evidence in the form of Kodachrome motion picture films (about 1600 frames). The Panel studied these films

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence of recovered physical craft, debris, or biological material, focusing exclusively on the analysis of sighting reports, photographic film, and administrative procedures for managing UAP data.
